Definition: Mishma, the name of a son of Ishmael, and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Mishma is the name of two men. One is a son of Ishmael, counted among the twelve princes of his house, and the other is a Simeonite whose sons are listed down to Shimei.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two lists keep the promise straight: Ishmael's sons became princes as God said, and the sons of Simeon are counted too, because every family is remembered.
